import Text from "../ui/text/Text.vue";
import Button from "../ui/button/Button.vue";

    <Messages :id="p.id" :error="p.error" />
    <Stack v-if="p.social === 'show'" gap="2" role="group" :aria-label="p.labels.providers" data-testid="authfly-providers">
      <Button v-for="pr in p.providers ?? []" :key="pr.id" :href="`${p.labels.socialUrl ?? ''}/${pr.id}`" :class="buttonSkin('outline', 'w-full')" :data-provider="pr.id"><LucideIcon :name="pr.icon" />{{ pr.title }}</Button>
